items.title: The pack entry select in the joint benchmark, and its result
items.summary: The benchmark adds select, the default packer of packing. The run 40743187036 has 130 pairs. The best pair is maxrects-cp+corners, with 42 misses on 222 inputs.

items.title: Verdicts over families, with their scope and breadth
items.summary: Version 0.2.11 adds familyBy, familyOf and the verdict over families. Version 0.2.12 adds the scope and the breadth of a verdict.

items.title: Strategy space as data (part 1)
items.summary: An engine writes its stages, options and param ranges as data. The contract checks a space, counts its points, and gives a grid or a seeded sample.

items.title: highways 0.8.1 in the joint benchmark: the ROUTE-SCALE fix
items.summary: The joint runner uses highways 0.8.1. That version computes the key of each shared link one time. The output of highways does not change.

items.title: highways 0.8.0 in the joint benchmark: the fixed lane order
items.summary: The joint runner uses highways 0.8.0. That version fixes the lane order of a run. The route hashes of shared and sections change one time, and no point moves.

items.title: Corpus claims, corpus hash and split checks
items.summary: The contract gets the corpus checks that packing, highways and the joint corpus share: the claims, the corpus hash and the folds of a split file.

items.title: Faster exact straight crossings, and a time for each step
items.summary: The joint runner counts the straight crossings with an exact and faster method. Each record also gives the time of each step.
